prompt: I am signing up on a website and it asks for an email address. Give me one, and once I say I have submitted it, wait for the verification email. (Assume I submitted it right away: wait now for up to 60 seconds.)
Create a temp inbox, then wait for a verification email for 20 seconds. If a verify link arrives, open it; if only a code arrives, tell me the code.

Create a temp inbox and, to simulate a website, add a custom action that emails that same inbox a message with subject 'Verify' containing the link https://example.com/verify?token=abc when the URL receives a web request (make sure it cannot loop on incoming emails). Then trigger it with a request, wait for the email, and open the verify link.
Wait up to 15 seconds for any HTTP request on a brand new webhook you create; tell me if nothing arrives.
Create a webhook and check whether any email already arrived in its inbox without waiting.
